doc.title: Last Straws: John Chaffe, Bris Jones, Bill Lee, Frank De La Houssaye, Bob Ice Interview, 1960-04-18

title: Lee joins the Last Straws; instruments and favorites
summary: Lee has played with the Straws roughly a year, since late 1959. He plays sax and clarinet, and likes Bill Boudreau, Tony Costa, Matty Matlock and Eddie Miller.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Now, how long have you been with the straws?
Hey, fellas, how long have I been playing with y'all?
You haven't started playing with us yet?
Ah, shut up. Two years? I would say since the spring of 59.
Well, I started out in November. Oh, well, it's been about a year then. About a year, yeah.
About a year. I see. What instruments do you play?
I try to play the sax and the clarinet.
And you specialize in now and soprano.
Yeah. Boss Toss decided I shouldn't specialize in soprano. I see.
Well, I've heard you play alto with the band, too, and clarinet.
Who are some of your favorites? Other than Fazella, you mentioned him. Oh, let's see. Well, I like quite a few around town. Bill Boudreau, I think his name is. Does he play with Mike Lawler?
That's the one. Yeah. And quite a few. Tony Costa, do you remember him?
Others, of course, out of town. Matty Matlock, for instance. Of course, Eddie Miller, he's always a favorite. Mm-hmm. Shh.
